name: Inchworm
description: The first clip crawls out of the frame like an inchworm: its back edge creeps forward and the picture humps up into a tall shaded arch, then its front edge reaches ahead and the arch flattens, two strides, uncovering the second clip behind. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: arch
params.description: How tall the arch grows toward the viewer
